name: Associated Students of Redwood State
description: Associated Students of Redwood State represents students on university committees and funds hundreds of campus events each year. All students are welcome to join.
meets: First Thursday of the month, 12:00–1:00 p.m.

name: Residence Hall Association
description: Residence Hall Association advocates for residents and plans hall programming across Madrone Hall and the other residence halls. All students are welcome to join.

name: Graduate Student Council
description: Graduate Student Council represents graduate students and runs the annual graduate research showcase. All students are welcome to join.

name: Computing Society
description: Computing Society hosts coding nights, tech talks, and the spring hackathon. All students are welcome to join.

name: Women in Engineering and Computing
description: Women in Engineering and Computing builds community among women and nonbinary students in engineering and computer science. All students are welcome to join.

name: Pre-Health Professions Society
description: Pre-Health Professions Society helps students prepare for medical, dental, and physician assistant programs. All students are welcome to join.

name: Student Nurses' Association
description: Student Nurses' Association supports nursing students with study groups, licensure exam preparation, and community health drives. All students are welcome to join.

name: Psychology Club
description: Psychology Club brings researchers and clinicians to campus and organizes graduate school workshops. All students are welcome to join.

name: History and Archives Collective
description: History and Archives Collective volunteers with the Sequoia Library archives and plans local history walks. All students are welcome to join.

name: Math Circle
description: Math Circle meets weekly to tackle competition problems and puzzles over pizza. All students are welcome to join.

name: Entrepreneurs Club
description: Entrepreneurs Club connects student founders with local mentors and runs a pitch competition. All students are welcome to join.

name: Robotics Team
description: Robotics Team designs and builds robots for regional collegiate competitions. All students are welcome to join.

name: Black Student Union
description: Black Student Union celebrates Black culture and advocates for Black students at Redwood State. All students are welcome to join.

name: Latinx Student Alliance
description: Latinx Student Alliance hosts cultural celebrations, mentorship, and family events for Latinx students. All students are welcome to join.

name: Native American Student Association
description: Native American Student Association organizes the spring powwow and supports Native students and community. All students are welcome to join.

name: Asian Pacific Islander Student Union
description: Asian Pacific Islander Student Union shares API cultures through food, film, and the Lunar New Year festival. All students are welcome to join.
meets: First Thursday of the month, 7:00–8:30 p.m.

name: Queer Student Union
description: Queer Student Union offers a welcoming space for LGBTQ+ students and allies. All students are welcome to join.
meets: First Thursday of the month, 5:00–6:00 p.m.

name: First-Generation Student Network
description: First-Generation Student Network connects first-generation college students with peers, faculty mentors, and resources. All students are welcome to join.

name: International Students Association
description: International Students Association welcomes international students and hosts the International Food Fair. All students are welcome to join.

name: Redwood Outdoors Club
description: Redwood Outdoors Club leads hiking, kayaking, and camping trips across the North Coast. All students are welcome to join.

name: Climbing Club
description: Climbing Club climbs at the campus wall and organizes weekend trips to local crags. All students are welcome to join.

name: Ultimate Frisbee (Club Sport)
description: Ultimate Frisbee competes in regional collegiate ultimate tournaments. All students are welcome to join.

name: Rugby Club
description: Rugby Club fields men's and women's club rugby sides in the regional union. All students are welcome to join.

name: Surf Club
description: Surf Club surfs local breaks together and teaches beginners ocean safety. All students are welcome to join.
meets: First Thursday of the month, 6:00–7:30 p.m.

name: Cycling Club
description: Cycling Club rides the coastal highways and races in collegiate road and mountain events. All students are welcome to join.
meets: First Thursday of the month, 6:00–7:30 p.m.

name: Redwood Chorale Society
description: Redwood Chorale Society supports the Redwood Chorale and organizes student-led a cappella nights. All students are welcome to join.

name: Theatre Guild
description: Theatre Guild produces student-directed plays and a spring musical. All students are welcome to join.

name: Film Society
description: Film Society screens independent films weekly and runs a short film festival. All students are welcome to join.

name: The Understory (Literary Magazine)
description: The Understory publishes student poetry, fiction, and art twice a year. All students are welcome to join.

name: Owl Radio 88.3 (Student Radio)
description: Owl Radio 88.3 broadcasts student-run music and talk shows to the Arcadia Falls area. All students are welcome to join.
meets: First Thursday of the month, 7:00–8:30 p.m.

name: The Redwood Ring (Student Newspaper)
description: The Redwood Ring covers campus news, sports, and opinion in print and online. All students are welcome to join.

name: Campus Sustainability Coalition
description: Campus Sustainability Coalition runs the campus garden, bike repair clinics, and waste audits. All students are welcome to join.

name: Campus Home Builders
description: Campus Home Builders builds affordable housing with local nonprofit partners. All students are welcome to join.

name: Owl Pantry Volunteers
description: Owl Pantry Volunteers stocks and staffs the free Owl Pantry in the Student Union. All students are welcome to join.
meets: First Thursday of the month, 5:00–6:00 p.m.

name: Disability Justice Collective
description: Disability Justice Collective advocates for access and disability culture on campus. All students are welcome to join.

name: Salmon Watch
description: Salmon Watch monitors local creeks and helps with habitat restoration projects. All students are welcome to join.

name: Chess Club
description: Chess Club meets for casual games, lessons, and rated tournaments. All students are welcome to join.

name: Tabletop Gaming Guild
description: Tabletop Gaming Guild gathers every week for board games and role-playing campaigns. All students are welcome to join.

name: Interfaith Council
description: Interfaith Council brings together students of many faith traditions for dialogue and service. All students are welcome to join.

name: Catholic Student Community
description: Catholic Student Community offers weekly gatherings, retreats, and service trips. All students are welcome to join.
